extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: dragster (drag racing car), approx. 6.0 x 1.9 x 1.9 m (L x W x H incl. rear wing), rear slicks 1.10 m, front wheels 0.44 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); steering wheel (dragster_steering_wheel) has its origin at its hub; open cockpit with roll cage, engine with blower and air scoop behind the driver, two-element rear wing, parachute pack; no brand, no text, no numbers

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
